posts.title: On dynamic activation functions (work in progress)
posts.html:
A small idea I have been chewing on. Most networks lock in one nonlinearity and call it done. What if the activation itself were not a fixed shape, but something the network shaped on its own, per layer or per input? Early experiments are interesting. I will write more once results are worth showing.

posts.title: My views on open source project
posts.html:
• at first it's sometime quite challenging to appeal to the interest of the people and to build something that is worth useful
  • LinkedIn is ----, I don't understand why there is so much AI stuff on LinkedIn, the thing it does is that it makes every project appear as same AI shit
  • In some of my previous projects I used AI for writing the post description but I don't anymore.
  • To build real is worth it i guess and the reason why i mentioned about LinkedIn is that i uploaded some of my work there but it was of no use:
    1. Maybe the people weren't interested.
    2. Maybe the project wasn't presented properly.
    3. Maybe LinkedIn isn't the right platform for this kind of project.

I made the stockit which is a kind of a bot that places the stocks on behalf of you, gives you the score for the stocks and also info about that company. I open sourced it but it didn't get much attention, maybe because of the reason mentioned above.

I need to work on improving the documentation for the future projects which obviously I'm gonna open source it :)
